values.name: Basic
values.description: Payment conditions normally applied.

values.name: End of month
values.description: Payments are due at end of month.

values.name: Fixed date
values.description: Payments are due on the fixed date specified.

values.name: Deferred
values.description: Payments are deferred beyond the normal due date.

values.name: Discount not applicable
values.description: Payment terms on which discounts are not applicable.

values.name: Mixed
values.description: Different payment terms negotiated under a documentary credit.

values.name: Extended
values.description: Payment is extended beyond the normal due date.

values.name: Basic discount offered
values.description: Payment terms reflect the basic offered discount.

values.name: Proximo
values.description: Occurring in the next month after present.

values.name: Instant
values.description: Payment is due on receipt of invoice.

values.name: Elective
values.description: Payment terms to be chosen by buyer (from options separately advised).

values.name: 10 days after end of month
values.description: Payment due ten days after end of a calendar month.

values.name: Seller to advise buyer
values.description: Seller will advise buyer of payment terms by separate transaction.

values.name: Paid against statement
values.description: Payments are to be made against statement.

values.name: No charge
values.description: Payment terms have no charge.

values.name: Not yet defined
values.description: Payment terms are not yet defined.

values.name: Ultimo
values.description: Payment is due the end of the current or specified month.

values.name: Previously agreed upon
values.description: Payment terms have been previously agreed upon.

values.name: United States funds
values.description: The payment terms require the use of United States funds.

values.name: Penalty terms
values.description: Payment terms on which penalties apply.

values.name: Payment by instalment
values.description: Payment terms are based on instalment payments.

values.name: Discount
values.description: Payment terms on which discounts are applicable.

values.name: Available by sight payment
values.description: Payment made at sight.

values.name: Available by deferred payment
values.description: Payment made at deferred date.

values.name: Available by acceptance
values.description: Payment on acceptance.

values.name: Available by negotiation with any bank
values.description: Payment made by negotiation with any bank.

values.name: Available by negotiation with any bank in ...
values.description: Payment made by negotiation with any bank in a specified location.

values.name: Available by negotiation by named bank
values.description: Payment made by negotiation with a specified financial institution.

values.name: Available by negotiation
values.description: Payment made by negotiation.

values.name: Adjustment payment
values.description: Payment adjusted for outstanding credits or debits.

values.name: Late payment
values.description: Payment after due date.

values.name: Advanced payment
values.description: Payment in advance of due date.

values.name: Payment by instalments according to progress (as agreed)
values.description: Payment by instalments according to progress (as agreed).

values.name: Payment by instalments according to progress (to be agreed)
values.description: Payment by instalments according to progress (to be agreed).

values.name: Nonstandard
values.description: Terms of payment differ from the normal terms.

values.name: Tenor payment terms
values.description: Payment to be made according to bilaterally agreed conditions between buyer and seller.

values.name: Complete payment
values.description: Payment must be made for complete value and may not be paid in instalments.

values.name: Payment terms defined in consolidated invoice
values.description: Payment terms are specified in a consolidated invoice.

values.name: Payment upon completion
values.description: The payment terms require payment upon completion.

values.name: Partial advance
values.description: The payment terms require a partial payment in advance of completion.

values.name: Consignment
values.description: The payment terms are that the goods will be paid for when they are sold or consumed.

values.name: Inter-company account
values.description: The payment terms involve the use of an inter-company account.

values.name: Sell by note
values.description: The payment terms involve a debtor who promises to pay a definite sum of money on demand or at a definite time in the future.

values.name: Supplier floor plan
values.description: The payment terms involve payment for merchandise owned by a third party.

values.name: Contract basis
values.description: The payment terms are based on a contract with a vendor.

values.name: Credit controlled
values.description: The payment terms involve the monitoring of credit by the grantor.

values.name: Dating given
values.description: The payment terms in which suppliers may extend seasonal dating.

values.name: Trade acceptance
values.description: A trade acceptance is a written acknowledgement of the sale of goods and promise to pay at a definite date and place.

values.name: Cost plus
values.description: The payment terms permit reimbursement of costs plus other authorised changes.

values.name: Letter of credit
values.description: The payment terms require the use of a letter of credit.

values.name: Lease agreement
values.description: The payment terms are included in the lease agreement.

values.name: Cash On Delivery (COD)
values.description: The payment terms are cash is due on delivery of merchandise.

values.name: Cash by state law
values.description: The payment terms are dictated by state law requiring payment of cash.

values.name: Bank transfer
values.description: The payment terms require the use of bank transfer.

values.name: Cash on arrival
values.description: The payment terms require payment by cash on arrival of the goods or services.

values.name: Cash
values.description: The payment terms are that payments are made in cash.

values.name: Cash discount terms apply
values.description: The payment terms are that a discount is applicable if the payment is made in cash.

values.name: Cash with order
values.description: The payment terms require the payment in cash with placement of the order.

values.name: Cash per vendor request
values.description: The payment terms involve a vendor request for payment by cash.

values.name: Irrevocable letter of credit
values.description: The payment terms require the use of an irrevocable letter of credit.

values.name: Documents against acceptance
values.description: The payment terms require acceptance of liability before document transfer.

values.name: Charge card
values.description: The payment terms permit the use of a charge card to effect payment.

values.name: Documents against payment
values.description: The payment terms require payment before document transfer.

values.name: Usance bill
values.description: The payment terms are based on the time allowed by commercial usage for the payment of foreign bills of exchange.

values.name: Letter of credit at sight
values.description: The payment terms require the presentation of a letter of credit.

values.name: Secured account
values.description: The payment terms call for the use of a secured account.

values.name: Basic commission terms
values.description: The payment terms call for the use of basic commission terms.

values.name: Deposit required
values.description: The payment terms require a deposit be provided.

values.name: Discount with prompt pay
values.description: The payment terms include a discount when payment is made within a time frame designated as prompt pay.

values.name: Discount with advance payment
values.description: The payment terms include a discount when payment is made in advance.

values.name: Certified cheque
values.description: The payment terms require the use of a certified cheque.

values.name: Cash against documents
values.description: The payment terms require cash payment before document transfer.

values.name: Bill of exchange
values.description: The payment terms require the use of bill of exchange.

values.name: Progressive discount
values.description: The payment terms include a progressive discount based on the amount and speed with which payments are made.

values.name: Lump sum
values.description: The payment term requires a lump sum payment.

values.name: Fixed fee
values.description: The payment term requires a fixed fee payment.

values.name: Mutually defined
values.description: A code assigned within a code list to be used on an interim basis and as defined among trading partners until a precise code can be assigned to the code list.
